Request reprint permissions here.By most accounts, China has the upper hand in its growing economic confrontation with the United States. In April 2025, after Washington levied heavy tariffs on China, Beijing responded with export restrictions on rare-earth minerals that led the Trump administration to back down. And in May 2026, when U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping met in Beijing, the American delegation fell short of even its very limited objectives.
